blocks.text: Day 4 · Breakfast and transfer to the airport for your flight to Medellín (not included). Welcome at José María Córdova International Airport and transfer to the hotel. Then a private city tour and Comuna 13 tour (7 hours): the Pueblito Paisa, a replica of a typical village of the region; San Antonio Park, San Ignacio Square, Avenida La Playa and the Coltejer Building; the mansions of the Prado neighbourhood; the Park of Wishes, Explora Park, the University of Antioquia and the Botanical Garden; the Atanasio Girardot Sports Complex and the old La Macarena bullring; the Plaza Mayor Convention Center, Parques del Río and the Parque de los Pies Descalzos; La Alpujarra, the Plaza de la Libertad and the Parque de las Luces; and El Poblado, with Parque Lleras and the Golden Mile. Continue to Comuna 13, by Metro and Metrocable, to discover its graffiti and the murals of local artists, telling stories of change and hope, ending at its famous outdoor escalators.

blocks.text: Day 5 · Breakfast, then a private excursion (8 hours) to El Peñol, with its replica of the original colonial town, and the majestic Piedra del Peñol, a granite monolith some 220 metres high; then the colourful town of Guatapé, famous for the zócalos, the decorated reliefs on its house fronts (explored by moto-taxi), and the reservoirs of El Peñol and Guatapé, where green mountains meet mirror-like water. A typical lunch at a local restaurant is included; the climb up the Piedra del Peñol and the boat trip on the reservoir are not included.
